messages:
Tara Nguyen: quick sync — planning org-scoped API key deprecation + service-auth provenance. need a minimal cutover plan that preserves auditability and avoids mass breaks
Morgan Patel: TL;DR we should bridge existing long-lived org keys, don't abruptly fail jobs. propose a token-exchange bridge for migrating callers incrementally
Lee Chen: options: A) on-first-use mint short-lived project-scoped tokens (exchange) B) proxy service that accepts org-key and returns project token + audit entry. tradeoffs: decentral vs central bottleneck
Sam Rivera: proxy is easier for rollout but becomes traffic chokepoint. alternative: local agent that does exchange + caches token for 1h, so only a subset hits central service
Aisha Gomez: agree on exchange. ensure original org id/key id is recorded in claims for provenance (e.g. claim `orig_org`, `orig_key_id`) and in audit store
Morgan Patel: implementation note: JWTs from exchange include `orig_org`, `orig_key_id`, `issued_by`, `exchange_ts`. backend enforcer must accept both legacy org-key and new token during grace window; map to same permissions
Tara Nguyen: rollout idea: start with 1% canary exchange path and capture diffs in behavior/latency. infra-bot can create canary namespace + dashboards
infra-bot: deploy: canary namespace 'authz-exchange-canary' created -> 2 pods. metrics hooked to prometheus job `authz_exchange_canary`
Lee Chen: need clear fallback: if exchange fails, allow org-key for read-only endpoints for 48h, reject writes (429). that reduces blast radius while we fix exchange issues
Sam Rivera: :thumbsup: also add `exchange_latency` and `exchange_failure_rate` metrics + alert if failures > 5% over 5m
Aisha Gomez: security checklist: require MFA for org-key rotation UI, log rotation events to audit store with retained `orig_key_id` mapping. update KMS rotation plan to not invalidate exchange proofs unexpectedly
Morgan Patel: I'll draft a short RFC with sequence diagram, claim schema, sampling plan, and canary criteria. target: review by EOD Fri and start canary next Tue
Tara Nguyen: SGTM. Morgan, drop RFC link here when ready and ping legal for retention/PII questions
Morgan Patel: will do — thanks everyone
thread_summary: Short sync about deprecating org-scoped API keys. Team agrees on token-exchange bridge that mints project-scoped tokens with provenance claims, canary rollout, caching agent option, failover rules, and telemetry/alerts. Morgan to draft RFC. infra-bot kicked off canary namespace.
